scope: Complete construction, inspection and acceptance of one explicitly designed open drainage channel: 450 m of selected precast reinforced-concrete U600x600-C35/45 channel at slope 0.003 and design flow 250 l/s. Earthworks, foundation layers, channel elements, joints, transitions, erosion protection, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are direct project inputs.
sourceAuthority: Approved surface-drainage design organization, hydraulic and geotechnical engineers, precast-channel manufacturer, construction laboratory and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved catchment calculation, plan, longitudinal profile and channel cross-section
approved channel type, material, internal geometry, slope and design-flow schedule
approved excavation, subbase, bedding, backfill and excess-soil quantities
approved geotextile, joint, concrete, grating, inlet-transition, outlet-transition and erosion-protection schedules
installation method with labor and mechanism quantities
conditional dewatering, excavation-shoring and road-restoration schedules
supplier channel-element length and approved retained spare length

rules.totalNeed: installed net length + retained spare length

forbiddenClaims: pipe, inlet, manhole, silt-trap or complete outlet scope inherited from a stormwater-network template
excavation, lining, restoration, labor or mechanism quantities derived from generic length coefficients
automatic inlet-transition, outlet-transition or joint spacing
automatic dewatering, shoring or road restoration
universal channel-element spare or supplier element length
